\title{Natural number addition}

\begin{section}{natural}
\heading{Natural number}
\parameters{natural number \(a\); natural number \(b\)}
  \begin{theorem}{clean-comm}
  \noaxioms
  \(a + b = b + a\).
  \begin{proof}
  Close the goal with \(cleancomm(a, b)\).
  \end{proof}
  \end{theorem}
\end{section}
